title: Lateness Multiplier Scale for the On-Time Credit — Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
On Repair and Emergency Service Calls, the on-time credit grows with how late the technician arrived. Lateness is measured from the end of the booked arrival window plus the arrival grace that applies to the customer. The arrival moment and the scheduled date are read from the call record.

**Scale.** The lateness multiplier is 2 when the technician arrived on a later calendar day than the scheduled date, or more than 120 minutes after the window end plus grace. It is 1.5 when the technician arrived on the same day more than 60 and no more than 120 minutes after the window end plus grace. It is 1 otherwise.

**Application.** The on-time credit figured for the call (its credit base) is multiplied by the lateness multiplier, and the product is rounded to the cent half up. In a call class whose on-time credit is zero, no multiplier applies.

| Arrival, measured from window end plus grace | Lateness multiplier |
|---|---|
| Later calendar day than the scheduled date | 2 |
| Same day, more than 120 minutes after | 2 |
| Same day, more than 60 and no more than 120 minutes after | 1.5 |
| Same day, up to 60 minutes after | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical: 08:00-12:00 window, 15-minute grace, so window end plus grace is 12:15)

| Arrival | Minutes after 12:15 | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 13:15 | 60 | 1 |
| 13:16 | 61 | 1.5 |
| 14:15 | 120 | 1.5 |
| 14:16 | 121 | 2 |
| 08:30 the next day | Later calendar day | 2 |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A credit base of $25.00 with an arrival 90 minutes after the window end plus grace is multiplied by 1.5, giving $37.50.
